verdict.rationale: Versioning is visible but only implied: the agentic-commerce cart API lives under a /v1/ path, Store Sync eligibility names an "Orders v2" integration, and the Agent Toolkit publishes semver releases on npm (1.11.0). Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-support guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit API versioning and changelog documentation, support windows for older versions, independent corroboration.
